name: Alert Type
description: Naarni-managed catalog of telemetry alert types. Customers subscribe to these (Alert Subscription); they do not author the parameter/operator themselves.

fields.label: Alert ID
fields.description: Stable machine id, e.g. pack_overheat. Lowercase snake_case. Used as the rule id by the alert engine.

fields.label: Available
fields.description: When unchecked, this alert type is hidden from the customer catalog.

fields.label: Telemetry Parameter
fields.description: Pick the telemetry column to watch.

fields.label: Parameter Type
fields.description: Numeric → set a threshold. Categorical/Boolean → pick a match value.

fields.label: Default Threshold
fields.description: Numeric params only — the value to compare against.

fields.label: Match Value
fields.description: Categorical/Boolean params — the value to match (dropdown of allowed values).

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Display unit shown beside the threshold, e.g. °C, km/h, %, V.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Emoji shown in the notification. Leave blank to use the severity default (🔴 critical / 🟠 warning).

fields.label: Display Title
fields.description: Human-facing title shown in notifications. Falls back to Alert Name.

fields.label: Message Template
fields.description: Custom notification line. Placeholders: {vehicle} {registration} {device} {parameter} {value} {unit} {op} {limit} {location} {maps} {time} {severity} {title}. Blank = default '{vehicle}: {parameter} is {value}{unit}'. Vehicle number + position are always shown in the card regardless.
